CustomField.description: QCC: Displays the repair cost of damage baggage
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(INCLUDES( Damage_Sustained__c , "Frame crushed"), INCLUDES( Damage_Sustained__c , "Completely destroyed") ) , "Unrepairable", IF(INCLUDES( Damage_Sustained__c , "Other"), "Not Known", IF(INCLUDES( Damage_Sustained__c , "Wheel snapped or broken off"), "AUD " & text(floor(Repair_Cost_numeric__c)) &"."& lpad(text((Repair_Cost_numeric__c-floor(Repair_Cost_numeric__c))*100),2,"0") & " (+ $41 per additional wheel)", "AUD " & text(floor(Repair_Cost_numeric__c)) &"."& lpad(text((Repair_Cost_numeric__c-floor(Repair_Cost_numeric__c))*100),2,"0")) ) )
CustomField.label: Estimated Repair Cost
